holes.name: Hole 1
holes.obstacleNotes: Fly-through: raised sand/straw pad, wide bare slope falling gently away to a basket framed by mossy oaks and pines.

holes.name: Hole 1 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Fly-through: raised sand/straw pad, wide bare slope falling gently away to a basket framed by mossy oaks and pines.

holes.name: Hole 2
holes.obstacleNotes: Fly-through: gravel road with a wooden fence on the right, moss oaks over the left near the tee, open gravel clearing mid-hole, then pines close in around a basket on a duff bank.

holes.name: Hole 2 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Fly-through: gravel road with a wooden fence on the right, moss oaks over the left near the tee, open gravel clearing mid-hole, then pines close in around a basket on a duff bank.

holes.name: Hole 3
holes.obstacleNotes: Fly-through: narrow gravel trail between wiregrass and palmetto, tall pines, dips through a gully then climbs under a big moss oak at the basket.

holes.name: Hole 3 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Fly-through: narrow gravel trail between wiregrass and palmetto, tall pines, dips through a gully then climbs under a big moss oak at the basket.

holes.name: Hole 4
holes.obstacleNotes: Fly-through: mulch tee with a rising bank on the left, big moss-draped oaks beside the dirt road mid-hole, fence and road open on the right, basket in dappled pines.

holes.name: Hole 4 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Fly-through: mulch tee with a rising bank on the left, big moss-draped oaks beside the dirt road mid-hole, fence and road open on the right, basket in dappled pines.

holes.name: Hole 5
holes.obstacleNotes: Fly-through: turf tee with a bench, tall pines, an eroded sand bank to the left, narrow red-sand trail then up onto a bare sandy knoll with green brush behind the basket.

holes.name: Hole 5 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Fly-through: turf tee with a bench, tall pines, an eroded sand bank to the left, narrow red-sand trail then up onto a bare sandy knoll with green brush behind the basket.

holes.name: Hole 6
holes.obstacleNotes: Fly-through: wooden tee platform over a wooded drop, steep bank down to a pale sandy pit with palmetto edges; basket on a rise at the far wall.

holes.name: Hole 7
holes.obstacleNotes: Fly-through: low turf tee past wiregrass, open sandy lane, big moss oaks on the left bank, dense scrub down the right.

holes.name: Hole 7 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Fly-through: low turf tee past wiregrass, open sandy lane, big moss oaks on the left bank, dense scrub down the right.

holes.name: Hole 8
holes.obstacleNotes: Fly-through: tee in tall wiregrass and palmetto, drop into a sandy bowl, one big moss oak mid-line, basket at the foot of a wooded bank.

holes.name: Hole 8 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Fly-through: tee in tall wiregrass and palmetto, drop into a sandy bowl, one big moss oak mid-line, basket at the foot of a wooded bank.

holes.name: Hole 9
holes.obstacleNotes: Fly-through: mulch tee in wiregrass, tall slender pines, steep drop past an eroded dirt cliff into a green bowl with the basket at the bottom.

holes.name: Hole 9 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Fly-through: mulch tee in wiregrass, tall slender pines, steep drop past an eroded dirt cliff into a green bowl with the basket at the bottom.

holes.name: Hole 10
holes.obstacleNotes: Sandy trail along a low spine: moss-hung oaks crowd the left, pines and brush the right; gently downhill to a basket on a bank by a lawn.

holes.name: Hole 10 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Sandy trail along a low spine: moss-hung oaks crowd the left, pines and brush the right; gently downhill to a basket on a bank by a lawn.

holes.name: Hole 11
holes.obstacleNotes: Tee on a built-up bank under huge spreading mossy oaks (one right on the line); drops through the oak meadow, closes into cedars and pines, then climbs to an elevated pine-duff clearing and basket.

holes.name: Hole 11 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Tee on a built-up bank under huge spreading mossy oaks (one right on the line); drops through the oak meadow, closes into cedars and pines, then climbs to an elevated pine-duff clearing and basket.

holes.name: Hole 12
holes.obstacleNotes: Deck tee above a wide open sandy lot (hay bales, flags); pines close the right; basket on a green patch at the foot of a grey limestone face.

holes.name: Hole 12 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Deck tee above a wide open sandy lot (hay bales, flags); pines close the right; basket on a green patch at the foot of a grey limestone face.

holes.name: Hole 13
holes.obstacleNotes: Deck tee by a wooden rail; straight lane through tall pines on dirt and needles, flat then a touch downhill, ending on rock rubble at the base of a limestone quarry wall.

holes.name: Hole 13 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Deck tee by a wooden rail; straight lane through tall pines on dirt and needles, flat then a touch downhill, ending on rock rubble at the base of a limestone quarry wall.

holes.name: Hole 14
holes.obstacleNotes: Long open pine-straw field: wide mown lane, sparse tall pines at the sides, hay bales and brush clumps, basket in front of a pine stand.

holes.name: Hole 14 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Long open pine-straw field: wide mown lane, sparse tall pines at the sides, hay bales and brush clumps, basket in front of a pine stand.

holes.name: Hole 15
holes.obstacleNotes: Long sand-track corridor between tall pines and moss oaks that closes in; a long slow dip, then it opens onto wiregrass clumps and a basket on a sandy knoll.

holes.name: Hole 15 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Long sand-track corridor between tall pines and moss oaks that closes in; a long slow dip, then it opens onto wiregrass clumps and a basket on a sandy knoll.

holes.name: Hole 16
holes.obstacleNotes: Tee on a sandy pine ridge, falls over rolling dirt mounds, then the lane bends right to a basket under moss-draped oaks.

holes.name: Hole 16 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Tee on a sandy pine ridge, falls over rolling dirt mounds, then the lane bends right to a basket under moss-draped oaks.

holes.name: Hole 17
holes.obstacleNotes: Tee on a hump under a moss oak with a palm; drops into a wooded gully with a dirt berm across the lane (pond lies left), bends to a grassy clearing with brush behind the basket.

holes.name: Hole 17 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Tee on a hump under a moss oak with a palm; drops into a wooded gully with a dirt berm across the lane (pond lies left), bends to a grassy clearing with brush behind the basket.

holes.name: Hole 18
holes.obstacleNotes: Tee on a high bluff of moss oaks and wiregrass, then a steep drop into the sandy quarry floor (OB-taped), a notch, then a flat mown finishing lawn ringed by banners.

holes.name: Hole 18 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Tee on a high bluff of moss oaks and wiregrass, then a steep drop into the sandy quarry floor (OB-taped), a notch, then a flat mown finishing lawn ringed by banners.

layouts.name: MPO Supreme Flight Open
layouts.description: Gold tees to Blue baskets, 18 holes, par 66 (par and tournament lengths from the Jomez DiscGolf broadcast of the 2026 Supreme Flight Open; holes 14, 16 and 18 from UDisc).

layouts.name: Red to Red
layouts.description: UDisc 'Red to Red' (par 61): Red tees to Red baskets.
